    b = []
    judge = False
    i = 0
    n = len(a)
    while i < n:
        # Check for "dot"
        if i != 0 and i <= n - 3 and a[i:i+3] == "dot":
            b.append('.')
            i += 3
        # Check for "at" (only first occurrence)
        elif i != 0 and i <= n - 2 and a[i:i+2] == "at" and not judge:
            b.append('@')
            i += 2
            judge = True
        else:
            b.append(a[i])
            i += 1
    print(''.join(b))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
